notes: Explore idea: a psychrometric calculator, the air-side sibling of hvac-load-calc and wall-condensation-check (duplicate_check top match 0.08). Engine: ASHRAE Fundamentals ch. 1 (Hyland-Wexler, ice below 0 C, wet bulb by bisection, any of 13 non-degenerate property pairs solved by scan + bisection), mixing by dry-air mass with fog flag, coil load/SHR/condensate/ADP/bypass, ADP-mode coil, sensible heat, evaporative cooler; SVG chart drawn for the pressure. Finding for the post: 80/67 -> 55/54 at 1,200 cfm is SHR 0.69 at sea level vs 0.61 at 5,280 ft (99.9 vs 78.2 gr/lb entering), and 4.5*cfm*dh reads 3.8% high. Verification: node --test 31/31; Chromium 390/1100 px no errors, no horizontal scroll, all six processes; tools.mjs call works; check_post_frontmatter and check_posts ok. No agent doc: README, llms.txt and VENTURE.yaml carry what the next run needs. Next: whole-system chart (OA + RA -> coil -> reheat), feed from hvac-load-calc design conditions, cross-check against a reference implementation. Local run_workflow_locally --for-changes: control-plane, checklist, conflict-markers, doc-refs, link-contrast, readme-live-links, page-integrity, agent-permission-harness, pages.yml all passed; prompts-ci failed only because the run record was still unfilled; sibling-links and the secondary-schema page test failed and were fixed (siblings --check ok, siblings.test 20/20, secondary-schema/faq-visible/css-lint 16/16, run_venture_tests on the three touched ventures 3/3 ok).
